# Synthetic fixture assets

`synthetic-details.svg` is a hand-authored, deterministic OCR fixture. Every value is fabricated; its `.test` email is for testing. The page exposes only a generic image description, so reading the image text requires visual processing.

`synthetic-face.png` is an AI-generated fictional portrait created with the built-in image-generation tool for Phase 1. It does not depict an intentionally referenced real person. The image is used only as a face-localization fixture; it is not evidence of general detection accuracy.

Generation prompt:

> Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: synthetic face detection test fixture for a local browser extension. Generate one square photograph-like portrait of a completely fictional adult person, front facing, head and shoulders, neutral expression, unobstructed clearly visible face centered taking roughly half the image width, even bright studio lighting, plain pale gray background. No real person reference, no text, no logos, no other faces. This is a synthetic computer-vision test asset, not a real identity.
